title: Endpoint Mapping Properties of Wave Operators for Two-Dimensional Schrödinger Operators
summary: We establish sharp endpoint mapping properties for the wave operators $W_\pm(H,-Δ)$ of two-dimensional Schrödinger operators $H=-Δ+V$ with real-valued decaying potentials $V$. Together with the known non-endpoint $L^p$ theory, our results give a complete classification of the $L^p$ mapping properties of the two-dimensional wave operators, and reveal an unexpected reversal of the usual threshold paradigm at the endpoints $p=1$ and $p=\infty$.
